data.name: Lucerne Lawn & Landscape Inc
data.headline: Dedham's Trusted Plumbers — Fast, Reliable Service Across Penobscot County
data.aboutText: Lucerne Lawn & Landscape Inc has been keeping homes and businesses in Dedham and the surrounding Penobscot County area flowing smoothly with dependable, no-nonsense plumbing services. Our team knows Maine homes inside and out — from aging pipes to modern bathroom upgrades — and we show up ready to get the job done right the first time. When you call us at 207-843-6667, you get straight answers, honest pricing, and a crew that treats your home like their own.

services.name: Emergency Callouts
services.blurb: Burst pipe at midnight or a leak that can't wait — Lucerne Lawn & Landscape Inc is on call to get to Dedham and nearby homes fast when plumbing problems strike at the worst time.

services.name: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.blurb: Maine winters are unforgiving, and our team keeps your boiler running efficiently all season long — whether you need a quick repair or a full system replacement.

services.name: Bathroom Installation
services.blurb: From a simple refresh to a full bathroom fit-out, Lucerne Lawn & Landscape Inc handles all the plumbing work to ensure everything is installed properly and built to last.

services.name: Leak Detection
services.blurb: Hidden leaks can cause serious damage before you even notice them — we use proven techniques to locate and fix leaks quickly, saving Dedham homeowners time and money.
